## Release

- Loaders:
  - `Fabric`
  - `NeoForge`
  - `Forge`
- Minecraft: `1.20.x`
- Java: `17+` (`21` for Minecraft `1.20.5` and `1.20.6`)
- Version: `5.6.0+mc1.20`

## Changelog

- Standardized Fabric artifacts as `ADL-<mod version>-Fabric-<Minecraft series>.jar`.
- Added Forge and NeoForge builds alongside Fabric.
- Added one runtime JAR per loader for the supported Minecraft 1.20 versions.
- Added normal equipment drop rolls for non-player kills according to `loot_drop_mode`.
- Added Brazilian Portuguese gamerule translations.
- Added compatibility across the 1.20.4/1.20.5 mapping transition and NeoForge 1.20.1 through 1.20.6.
- Fixed legacy Forge loading and zombie-death crashes.
- Updated the mod author and project contact links.
